description: Candidate demo songs for parapara: plain CC BY tracks at ~140-160 BPM that pass the suitability check (parapara.audio.suitability). AUDIO IS NOT IN GIT: download from page_url/audio_url (or the team's shared drive) and import with `uv run parapara-import-song <file> --catalog <id>`. Show the attribution text in the game's credits. Re-check the licence on the page before use: artists can change it.

searched.free_music_archive: CC BY filter; queries trance, techno, dance, edm, hardstyle, hard trance, happy hardcore, chiptune, uptempo, eurobeat, j-pop, rave, speed (no Eurobeat/Eurodance/Hi-NRG results). ~50 plain CC BY tracks measured; most dance tracks were 115-130 BPM.
searched.jamendo: not searched: the API needs a developer client_id (free at devportal.jamendo.com); run `JAMENDO_CLIENT_ID=... uv run parapara-find-songs` to search it.
